remarks: Located in a desirable, convenient West Seneca neighborhood, this  inviting 3 bdrm,1.5 bath Colonial has been lovingly owned by the same owners for 50 years! The thoughtfully designed layout offers  a spacious living room, formal dining room and separate family room there is plenty of space for everyday living and entertaining. The eat in kitchen features sliding glass doors leading to the deck and a large fully fenced backyard-perfect for outdoor enjoyment.  3 nice sized bedrooms and a full bath upstairs. Additional highlights include a 2 car attached garage. There is zoned baseboard heat and additionally there is central air. Ready for your personal touch, some updates and a little sweat equity will go a long way in making this home shine. A wonderful opportunity to build equity and make this well-loved home your own in a sough after West Seneca location near schools, shopping , and stores.  Located in West Seneca West School District. Sellers reserve the right to set a deadline for offers.
